title: Changing status needs Delete permission, otherwise the option is hidden
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. Sign in as a user WITHOUT "Part Library & Inventory - Delete".
custom_steps:
1. On the Active tab open the actions menu and look for "Deactivate parts"; on the Inactive tab look for "Activate parts".
  2. Confirm Cycle count and Export are still present and usable.
  3. Open a part's edit dialog and look for the Deactivate/Activate control.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Deactivating and activating a part require the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission; a user without it does not see the "Deactivate parts" entry on the Active tab or "Activate parts" on the Inactive tab, and does not see the Deactivate/Activate control in the edit dialog.
  • The actions menu itself and its Cycle count and Export entries are unaffected - only the bulk-status entry is gated.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 8 (Permissions); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R1: “Deactivating a part requires the user to have the 'Part Library & Inventory - Delete' permission enabled.”
  • S8-R2: “Activating a part requires that same setting.”
  • S8-R3: “A user without that setting does not see the "Deactivate parts" entry in the Inventory actions menu, so there is no way for them to enter the mode from the Active tab.”
  • S8-R4: “The same user does not see the "Activate parts" entry on the Inactive tab.”
  • S8-R15: “The actions menu itself, and its Cycle count and Export entries, are unaffected by that setting. Only the bulk status entry is gated.”
  • S8-R16: “That same user does not see the Deactivate or Activate control in the part edit dialog.”
